summary.short: Vietnam's Law No. 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection, promulgated 26 June 2025 by the National Assembly and in force from 1 January 2026. The fetched page contains only metadata; its operative provisions are not in the document.
summary.long: Law No. 91/2025/QH15 on Personal Data Protection (luật Bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân) is a statute of the National Assembly of Vietnam, promulgated 26/06/2025 and in force from 01/01/2026, as shown in the page metadata. The supplied document is the official gazette web page. It records the title, issuing body, dates, signatory (Trần Thanh Mẫn) and gazette issue (971 + 972), but its articles are not included. The obligations, addressees, thresholds, enforcement and territorial scope of the law therefore cannot be coded from this text. The classification is limited to the subject matter named in the title and the binding character of a statute.
